description.value: Sun Peaks Lodge is a full-service mountain hotel situated in the heart of Sun Peaks Resort village, offering traditional rooms and studios with kitchenettes steps from the chairlift with ski-in/ski-out access. The lodge features an on-site steakhouse, a Swiss-style Fondue Stube, and a wellness area with hot tub, sauna, and steam room. It also offers a bike rental service on-site and sits within easy reach of the resort's biking and hiking trails, making it a practical base for cycling tourism in the Thompson-Okanagan region.

address.value: 3180 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence. The rooms page confirms free Wi-Fi in all rooms, and the front page and navigation confirm on-site dining (Steakhouse, Fondue Stube) and a 'Ski- & Bike Rental' service. No website passage mentions secure overnight bike storage, staff bike procedures, laundry, drying area, pump, tools, or bike wash; the bike rental service exists but does not confirm storage. OSM phone, address, and website all corroborate the website's contact details exactly.
concerns: OSM address omits postal code; website confirms V0E 5N0 — address updated accordingly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sun Peaks Lodge is a real, operational hotel actively taking bookings and advertising 2026 seasonal promotions; clearly useful to touring cyclists as a full-service accommodation base near biking trails.
enrichment_extras.notes: Lodge has an on-site 'Ski- & Bike Rental' service (listed in website navigation), which may imply some bike-handling infrastructure, but no specific secure overnight storage details were found on the website.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Steakhouse and Fondue Stube; website also describes the village as having 'charming shops and delectable restaurants lining the streets'
